title: Saudi Arabian Pepper Roast
description: Deliciously marinated Arabian roast with a kick of pepper, inspired by traditional Saudi flavors.

ingredients.name: Saudi Arabian roast
ingredients.notes: Look for a high-quality, grass-fed roast

ingredients.name: Pepper
ingredients.notes: Use a mix of black and white pepper for added flavor

ingredients.name: Juicy juice
ingredients.notes: Your preferred brand or freshly squeezed

ingredients.name: Arabian spice blend
ingredients.notes: Available at most Middle Eastern markets or online

ingredients.name: Olive oil
ingredients.notes: For brushing the roast during cooking

instructions: In a small bowl, whisk together the juicy juice, Arabian spice blend, and 1 teaspoon of the ground pepper.
Rub the marinade all over the Saudi Arabian roast, making sure to coat it evenly.
Place the roast in a large Dutch oven or oven-safe pot, and brush with olive oil.
Cover the pot with a lid and roast in the preheated oven for 2 1/2 hours, or until the internal temperature reaches 135°F (57°C) for medium-rare.
Remove the roast from the oven and let it rest for 10 minutes before slicing.
Sprinkle the remaining 1 tablespoon of ground pepper over the sliced roast, and serve.
